Posterior predictive errors on a fitted mvgam model

Source: R/brms_wrappers.mvgam.R
predictive_error.mvgam.Rd

Posterior draws of the prediction error, observed minus predicted, of each observation on the response scale. The arguments are those of brms::predictive_error.brmsfit().

Usage

# S3 method for mvgam
predictive_error(
  object,
  newdata = NULL,
  re_formula = NULL,
  re.form = NULL,
  method = "posterior_predict",
  resp = NULL,
  ndraws = NULL,
  draw_ids = NULL,
  sort = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fitted mvgam object from mvgam().

newdata

Optional data frame with covariates for prediction. If NULL, uses original training data stored in the model object.

re_formula

Group-level terms to include: NULL (the default) for every one, NA for none. A formula choosing some of them is not supported.

re.form

The lme4 name for re_formula.

method

"posterior_predict" (the default) takes the errors from predictive draws, "posterior_epred" from expected values.

resp

Character specifying which response variable for multivariate models. NULL (default) returns predictions for all responses.

ndraws

Positive integer specifying number of posterior draws to use. NULL (default) uses all available draws.

draw_ids

Optional integer vector selecting a subset of posterior draw indices to use. NULL (default) uses all draws (subject to ndraws).

sort

Logical. TRUE orders the columns by the observed response. Defaults to FALSE.

...

Further arguments of the method function, such as incl_autocor or allow_new_levels.

Value

An [ndraws, nobs] matrix of observed minus predicted values.

Details

The errors are those residuals.mvgam() returns with type = "ordinary". In sample, each prediction carries the latent trend state the model inferred at that time. A prediction for newdata integrates over the trend dynamics.

See also

brms::predictive_error.brmsfit(), residuals.mvgam(), posterior_predict.mvgam(), posterior_epred.mvgam().
